title: Flora Creative Studio · music video production

elements.text: The offer is modular: you take only what your clip needs, from a simple shoot to the full cycle. That keeps the budget under control, with nothing paid for in excess.

items.text: Basic (1 fixture, 60 and 100 W) suits one person in frame, indoors or outdoors. Three 500 W fixtures noticeably raise the image quality.
Atmospheric haze: the image gains depth and volume. Covers a room up to 100 m².
Aerial filming depends on the location: some zones are no-fly. We confirm in advance.

elements.text: How deeply I'm involved in the idea is up to you. Three formats:

items.name: No script
items.text: The client handles all the prep: references, script, shot plan. On set I direct: I follow the ready plan, set the light and run the process. We shoot strictly to your script.

items.name: Involvement
items.text: You handle the organisation, locations and script and gather references. I give notes and suggest what works better. On set I cover the same: I run the filming to the plan and set the light.

items.name: Full service
items.text: I take on everything. First we discuss your wishes and ideas, then within a week or two I send references and several concept options. We refine over a few rounds to the final. Scouting locations and all approvals are on me too.

elements.text: The price depends on a few things:

items.text: the volume of footage and number of locations;
the complexity the client sets (effects and so on).

elements.text: I give the exact figure after the script is approved. Editing includes footage selection, rhythm, colour correction, sound and 2 rounds of revisions.
Tick what you need and see an approximate total. Editing can be switched off if you don't need it; the exact editing figure is fixed after the script.

config.fine: Prices are final, PVN is not added. Editing can be switched off. When included, it's counted at the minimum (200 €) and can reach 600 € depending on complexity.

rows.label: Editing
rows.sub: from 200 to 600 €, exact after the script

elements.text: These are just examples of how an estimate adds up. The total depends on the scope you choose.

items.text: Script 100 % upfront. Filming: 20 % deposit, 80 % on the shoot day. Editing: 50 % at the end of the shoot day, 50 % on delivery.
Script about a week, two at most. The finished clip usually within 2 weeks after filming. If you need a rush, we arrange it separately.
A clip can be filmed in one day or a few hours, or across several days.
In Riga 20 €. Up to 20 km from Riga 50 €, up to 50 km 100 €, further by arrangement.
2 rounds included. If no notes arrive within a week of the sent version, it is considered accepted.

close.cta: Open to discussing the idea and project details. Write to me and we'll put together a version for you.
